Hi Aisha 

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Really appreciate the context on ZenWell's priority to reduce per-case transcription latency and to centralize inference for clinical summarization. Per our conversation, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the project. High-level recap and ask below.

Quick recap from discovery:
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization for ambulatory clinics. Must keep PII in-region and reduce latency under 300ms for short summaries.
- Key stakeholders: CTO (Rajiv), Head of Security (Maya), Procurement (TBD), Clinical Ops (you).
- Preferred deployment: Dedicated or Private (customer-managed VPC) depending on compliance review.

Initial MAP (draft) 

1) Kickoff & finalize scope
Owner: ZenWell (Aisha) / Redwood (Marissa)
Target: 2026-03-22
2) Security questionnaire & SOC 2 artifact review
Owner: ZenWell (Maya) / Redwood (Nikhil)
Target: 2026-03-29
Dependency: SOC 2 report + DPA
3) Technical trial (POC) & perf validation
Owner: Redwood (Aditya) / ZenWell (Dev lead)
Target: 2026-04-19
Dependency: test dataset + access (staging VPC)
4) Procurement & commercial terms finalization
Owner: ZenWell (Procurement) / Redwood (Marissa)
Target: 2026-06-30 (target close)
5) Pilot rollout & monitoring
Owner: ZenWell / Redwood
Target: 2026-07-31

Two timeline options we discussed:
- Aggressive: POC complete by 2026-04-05, procurement by 2026-05-15, target close early June (requires rapid SOC 2 artifact exchange and procurement prioritization).
- Standard: POC complete by 2026-04-19, procurement finalized by 2026-06-30 (recommended if procurement/security need more review time).

Ask: Please confirm the stakeholder list (add names/emails for Procurement + Dev lead), confirm which timeline you'd prefer (aggressive/standard), and confirm the target close date (I penciled 2026-06-30).

I've attached the initial MAP (ZenWell_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) and included a HubSpot link for the deal in related links. If helpful, can set a 30-min MAP kickoff review next week to walk through milestones.

Thanks
